verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents an AI avatar interview feature that collects responses and organizes the results into an AI-generated report, so it produces AI insights from data inside the product. It also documents AI coaching feedback with scoring in roleplay practice. This only covers interview and roleplay data, and nothing shows general AI insights or suggestions across a user's broader data, such as video analytics. Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions over general workspace or video-performance data, detail on what the AI-generated reports contain, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: organizes results into an AI-generated report, individual responses, transcripts
An AI avatar asks the creator’s questions, follows up where more detail would be useful, and organizes results into an AI-generated report
an AI avatar that gives conversational coaching feedback alongside scoring
